description: This file contains unit tests for the NATS stream adapter in an Orleans-based streaming application. It sets up connection and stream context, initializes and disposes of streams, and performs send/receive tests to verify message publishing and consuming via NATS, including validation of message order and cache contents.

classes.name: NatsAdapterTests
classes.description: Unit test class for testing NATS stream adapter functionality in Orleans, including setup, teardown, and message exchange validation.

methods.name: NatsAdapterTests
methods.description: Constructor that initializes connection, context, and stream name; checks for NATS availability.

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Sets up the test environment by connecting to NATS and ensuring the stream is clean.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Cleans up the test environment by deleting the stream and disposing the connection.

methods.name: SendAndReceiveFromNats
methods.description: Integration test method that sets up the adapter factory and runs send/receive validations.

methods.name: SendAndReceiveFromQueueAdapter
methods.description: Performs actual message sending, receiving, and cache validation to verify messaging flow.

methods.name: CreateEvents
methods.description: Helper method to generate a list of random integer and string events for testing.
